title: Places on the island
question: Which of these should the island have? The onsen and beach are already going on the map. Tick any; they go into the next map rounds.

options.label: Shotengai: covered shopping street (konbini, bakery, drugstore, 100-yen shop)
After-hours food: ramen stand, standing soba, yakitori izakaya under the tracks, a snack bar
Sento and coin laundry by the dorms
Company clinic and the health-check building
Post office, ATM corner and a tiny police box
Small company shrine on a headland (ties in with kotodama)
Sports field for undokai, morning radio exercises on the plaza
Company history hall and the founder's statue
Old buildings: disused factory, old power plant, early-90s server hall
Karaoke box and a small game centre
Footbath by the station (onsen already added)
Fishing pier by the beach (beach already added)
Viewpoint park looking back at the mainland
Cherry-tree path and a summer matsuri stage
Water tower, desalination plant, power station, incinerator (IT ticket spots)
Housing tiers: singles' dorms, family housing, executives' hill

decision: Picked: shotengai (konbini+100-yen+drugstore combined), ramen+izakaya, sento+laundry, one clinic, shrine, history hall, old-industry section, karaoke+game centre, viewpoint, sakura+matsuri, harbour. Undokai on the existing field; training inside an office; utilities hidden; uniform housing with some luxury. No koban/post, no footbath. Recorded in docs/game/setting.md.
